readiness.hed: Fredericksburg stays unsettled through this evening with a 60 percent chance of light rain and a high near 64, clears to patchy morning fog and a milder, foggy-to-partly-sunny Monday near 72, then turns sharply colder and sunny by Tuesday with a high near 53 and an overnight low around 27
readiness.insight: The National Weather Service shows no active watches or warnings for Fredericksburg this afternoon. Rain is likely through early evening with a 60 percent chance and a high near 64, tapering to a 50 percent chance of light rain and patchy fog overnight with a low around 52. Monday brings patchy fog before 10 a.m., then partly sunny skies with a high near 72 before temperatures fall back to the mid-60s in the afternoon, followed by a 30 percent chance of rain Monday night as a low around 37 moves in with gusts to 22 mph. Tuesday turns sharply colder and sunny with a high near 53 and an overnight low around 27.
actions: Rain lingers into early evening — get any outdoor errands, dog walks, or church-grounds work done before dark if you want to stay dry.
Monday's morning fog means an earlier commute should slow down and use headlights; it clears by midmorning into the week's mildest afternoon near 72.

Monday night's wind gusts to 22 mph and a roughly 35-degree swing from Monday's high to Tuesday's overnight low are worth a last gutter-and-drain check and securing anything loose outdoors before the cold front moves through.
Tuesday's sunny 53-degree high with a 27-degree overnight low is the week's first hard freeze — bring in sensitive plants and check on elderly neighbors before Tuesday night.
